# Best video + audio
-f bv*+ba/b

# Force MP4 container
--merge-output-format mp4

# Organized folders
-o "%(uploader)s/%(upload_date)s - %(title)s.%(ext)s"

# Subtitles (manual + auto-generated only)
--write-subs
--write-auto-subs
--sub-langs all
--extractor-args "youtube:skip=translated_subs"
--embed-subs
--convert-subs srt

# Thumbnail
--write-thumbnail
--convert-thumbnails png
--embed-thumbnail

# Metadata
--add-metadata
--embed-metadata

# Description
--write-description

# Full metadata archive
--write-info-json

# Chapters
--embed-chapters

# Resume downloads
--continue

# Avoid overwriting
--no-overwrites

# Retry robustness
--retries infinite
--fragment-retries infinite

# Rate limit protection
--sleep-requests 2
--sleep-interval 2
--max-sleep-interval 5

# Avoid duplicate downloads
--download-archive C:/yt-dlp/archive.txt

# Safer filenames for Windows
--restrict-filenames
